About the author

Chris is a London based author who has had a passion for writing ever since he was a young boy. This joy has existed alongside a pursuit in physical activity, from playing competitive sports such as football, all the way to competing in bodybuilding shows. An emerging author in the Cyberpunk genre, Chris has also written a Romance story, as well as a Time Travel series. Chris's books are fast-paced thrill rides that will leave you on the edge of your seat, desperate for more.
